    cfg = subprocess.run(["cmake", "-S", str(svc_dir), "-B", str(bdir)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    if cfg.returncode != 0:
        return False, f"CMake configure failed for {target_bin}: {cfg.stderr.strip()}"
    bld = subprocess.run(
        ["cmake", "--build", str(bdir), "--target", target_bin, "-j4"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120
    )
    if bld.returncode != 0:
        return False, f"CMake build failed for {target_bin}: {bld.stderr.strip()}"
    runner = ["dbus-run-session", "--", str(bdir / target_bin)] if shutil.which("dbus-run-session") else [str(bdir / target_bin)]
    exe = subprocess.run(runner, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
